text: This report recommends that the name "Leslie Ridge Lane" be approved to identify an existing Public Lane located north of Gerrard Street East, extending easterly from Leslie Street. This naming proposal complies with the City of Toronto Street Naming Policy which can be found at https://www.toronto.ca/city-government/planning-development/street-naming/
The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Approved the name "Leslie Ridge Lane" for an existing Public Lane located north of Gerrard Street East, extending easterly from Leslie Street.
